purpose: Machine-readable capability and evidence matrix across protectors, versions, configurations and semantic recovery pipelines. Strictly separates local projection/AST/SMT proof from full business recovery. Never equates local exit 0, partial trace or model narrative to full devirtualization success.

statusLabels.verified: Complete function business contract proved across multiple independent inputs and paths, with SMT/DAG equivalence and reproducible deployment.
statusLabels.partial: Subset of trace, individual handler body, local SMT DAG or single execution path verified; full business recovery, alternate paths or whole binary remain unproven.
statusLabels.blocked: Execution or analysis safely halted by host application control policy (e.g. 4551), anti-virus quarantine, or protective safety boundaries; never bypassed.
statusLabels.unverified: No qualified sample, zero function return within budget, or unmodeled/unsolved constraints remain.

strengthLabels.observed: Direct execution or analysis tool call with verified digest and recorded receipts.
strengthLabels.formal: Deterministically checked mathematical or SMT UNSAT/SAT certificate across the input domain.
strengthLabels.inferred: Derived from mechanism or structural analysis without direct input-output proof.
strengthLabels.unknown: Open research gap, missing evidence, or intentionally preserved unresolved state.

Methodology for separating disk/runtime states, distinguishing initialization/fixup from true VM execution, and extracting runtime bytecode.

features.formalScope: 16/32/64-bit register-source BSR/BSF matching raw Sleigh CFG (3 internal edges, step bounds 83/164/323 and 99/196/387), destination register and all 6 status flags (CF, PF, AF, ZF, SF, OF) proved dead.
48 register-condition-width shapes across 16/32/64-bit with full upper-32 zero-clearance and flags preserved.
Byte-identical executable section mapping for RIP-relative instructions; switches decoded instruction address without blind constant rebasing.
Strict refusal when undefined/unmodeled flags (MUL/IMUL ZF, ADD/CMP AF, SHL/ROL OF) cross into live GPRs, memory stores or control transfers.
Full RSP-8/STORE return address/BRANCH nextEA shape preserved with directCall metadata.
